# geometric-computer

> The v23 geometric-computing stack, gated: L1 primorial fold codec (lossless state⇄number) + L2 Entropic Torus Harmonics (which fold-signatures are stable — golden holds, resonance cancels). Proof-of-play CLEAN.

geometric-computer is a sovereign, MIT-licensed build by Simon Gant (UK) — it runs in the browser, is free to own and fork, and is part of the AI Native Solutions estate. Source and a live page are linked below.
